name: Diego Lopes
summary: A Brazilian featherweight from Lobo Gym in Mexico (28-8, age 31), moving up to lightweight. He lost two five-round decisions to Alexander Volkanovski for the featherweight title (April 2025 and January 2026), and in between and since knocked out Jean Silva (R2) and Steve Garcia (R2, June).

how_they_fight.Striking: Wild, powerful and creative: spinning attacks and heavy hooks. Twelve knockouts, six in R1 and five in R2.
how_they_fight.Grappling: A real submission threat: twelve submissions, nine in R1, often off scrambles and from his back.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped twice, both in R2 (early career). Gets hit in exchanges but recovers.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Kept pace over five rounds twice with Volkanovski but lost both on the cards.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Takes risks to finish; can be out-pointed by technical boxers.

patterns: Fast finisher: R1-R2 knockouts and submissions
concerns: First fight at 155 against a bigger, elite grappler
Lost both five-round decisions to Volkanovski
keys_to_beat: Out-point him with clean, disciplined boxing
Beat him in the scrambles he invites

news.text: Discussed the logistics of moving up to lightweight for this fight.
